title: TransLogWest
description: translogwest.de TransLogWest S.L. is a Spanish freight forwarding and logistics company founded in 2012 in Bilbao, Basque Country, specializing in international maritime, air, road and rail transport with customs clearance services. With around 20 employees and offices in Galdakao (Bizkaia) and Madrid, it positions itself as a boutique logistics partner for mid-sized businesses. The company holds AEO, IATA and FIATA certifications enabling streamlined customs processing and multimodal transport worldwide. Its services cover FCL and LCL container shipping, air freight, project cargo, dangerous goods, warehousing and temperature-controlled logistics. Key strengths are personalized service, full multimodal capability and European customs expertise. It serves clients across Europe, Asia, Latin America and North Africa.
